pressesOneHelp: Best when you take the money as you hand the food over. You get a single button, “Mark paid & picked up”, which records the payment and clears the order together.
pressesTwoHelp: Best when payment and handover happen at different moments — someone pays at the hatch, then picks up when it’s ready. You get two buttons: “Mark paid” first, then “Picked up” when they take the food.
